meta.title: Agent bus
meta.description: Lets sessions in this profile leave each other messages: agent_bus_post delivers to another live session's next model step, agent_bus_inbox lists peers and received messages, and agent_bus_status shows what each peer is doing. Cross-session text is labelled untrusted data; consecutive automatic back-and-forth is rate-limited (3 rounds per 10 minutes by default) and reopens by itself, and a paused send returns ok:false instead of an error.
